trailheadDirection: Drive Highway 16 (the Yellowhead) to Mount Robson Provincial Park, about 90 km west of Jasper and a short way east of the Highway 5 junction near Valemount. Turn off at the Mount Robson visitor centre and follow the paved side road about 2 km to the trailhead parking lot at its end. Check the park's trail status before you go: the trail closed after flood damage in 2021 and reopened in full in 2025.
